assertions.description: window.subApps is exposed inside Isolated Contexts and hidden everywhere else — a hosted tab must NOT see it, an isolated-app:// window must.
The SubApps interface object follows the same [IsolatedContext] exposure gate as the window.subApps attribute.
The spec hangs subApps off Window; nothing named subApps may appear on Navigator.prototype.
The sub-apps policy-controlled feature is only advertised by document.featurePolicy.features() inside Isolated Contexts.
When exposed, subApps has callable add(), remove(), and list(); when hidden, the SubApps interface object is hidden too.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof window.subApps==='undefined')return typeof window.SubApps==='undefined';const s=window.subApps;return typeof s.add==='function'&&typeof s.remove==='function'&&typeof s.list==='function';})()

assertions.description: subApps.add(installPaths) resolves to { installedApps, failedApps } records keyed by the input install paths, mapping to ManifestId on success and DOMException on per-app failure.
assertions.test: Requires an installed Isolated Web App and a user-approved install prompt; cannot execute in a hosted tab.

assertions.description: add(), remove(), and list() all reject with SecurityError when the sub-apps permissions policy is not granted to the top-level document.
assertions.test: Requires an installed Isolated Web App served with Permissions-Policy: sub-apps=() to trigger; cannot execute in a hosted tab.

assertions.description: add() rejects wholesale with QuotaExceededError beyond 50 installed sub-apps per parent IWA or more than 20 install paths in a single prompt.
assertions.test: Requires an installed Isolated Web App issuing oversized batches; cannot execute in a hosted tab.
